siteTerms.check: No scraper and no CI job fetches Apple or other third-party pages. Values are re-measured by hand from public pages or read from Apple's public documentation, and enter the repository only as own-words claims in evidence/ledger.json. Whether Apple's site terms also cover manual collection is unverified.

measuringMethod: By hand in a browser from public pages, or from Apple's public developer documentation. Measured values from third-party sites are context, never defaults, tokens or error thresholds.
neverShip: SF Pro, SF Pro Icons (including U+F301) and SF Symbols
class names, module ids or media URLs of measured sites
product or device images and store badges
palettes, type scales, tracking, radii, navigation metrics or breakpoints copied from a measured site
a replica of an Apple web page

appleText.allowed: Titles cited as sources, attributed quotes of at most 20 words, API-call boilerplate made of public symbol names, and phrases of at most 12 words that a part's appleText records with their source.
appleText.corpus: The appleText passages recorded in vendor/sources.json. Apple's documentation pages, the Swift book, swift.org, Swift Evolution and Apple's MIT samples are not in the corpus yet; NOTICE.md states the gap.

signOff.accepted: The owner chose the skill name apple and the Apple logo as its icon, accepting the trademark risk; the logo stays outside the MIT licence and is replaced if Apple asks.
